pull_request.body: Random-direction controls are numbered 0..k-1, so they share numbers with neurons 0..k-1. `/api/units` and `/api/unit` looked names up by number alone, so with "show random" on, control r3 in the list carried neuron N3's name (and matched the name filter), and opening r3 showed N3's name and N3's rank among neurons. Names now apply to neurons only, and `rank`/`n_ranked` are counted within the unit's own kind (unchanged for neurons). Tested by calling `server.units` and `server.unit` on a small synthetic run with a named N3 and a control r3 (transformers and the runtime stubbed out): before, r3 returned the name 'owl neuron'; after, it returns '' and its rank among controls, and N3 is unchanged.
pull_request.title: Explorer: random controls no longer show the same-numbered neuron's name and rank
